__comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
The chapter-list API again, with every shape this backend varies sent the
other way round. Its pair is chapter-list.json; see series-single.html for
the live failure on 2026-09-16 that made a second shape necessary, and
PLAN §9 for why a fixture that only ever shows one of them is not evidence.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- `data` is a bare object rather than an array of one. This is the same
serialiser behaviour that broke md_titles, applied to the envelope: a
series with exactly one chapter is where it would show, and a series
- `group_name` is a bare string rather than an array of one
- `chap` and `vol` are numbers rather than text. They are text in every
response observed, and they are the two fields an API of this kind
emits unquoted sooner or later — 7, not "7". The number must survive
as written, because order.go reads it.
Why synthetic: see testdata/search.json. Host is example.invalid (RFC 2606).
